origin.description: A normal confidence interval for the fractional difference.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: A fracdiff fit. In Python the argument is obj.

origin.details: The interval is the estimate plus the standard error times the normal quantiles of (1-level)/2 and one minus that. The quantile is SciPy's ppf, which matches R's qnorm here.
